Download ExcelDownload PDF **29** Checkpoints **2** Sections As needed Site Engineer [IS 516:1959](https://infralens.in/code/IS-516-Part-2-1959) [IS 456:2000](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456-2000) Related [📐IS 516](https://infralens.in/code/IS-516) [✏️Cube Acceptance Criteria M25](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/cube-acceptance-criteria-m25) [📘Concrete Cover Requirements](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-cover) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | REG. CUBE SPECIMEN LIFECYCLE LOG - COLUMN DEFINITIONS | | COL-01 | S.No
Acceptance: Sequential numbering from 1 onwards | Serial number for each cube set entry | | | COL-02 | Cube Set ID
Acceptance: Unique across project; linked to Pour Register (QC-CON-REG-001) | Unique identifier for the cube set (e.g., SET-001, CS-P1-001) | | | COL-03 | Date Cast
Acceptance: Same as pour date; time of casting recorded (HH:MM) | Date and time when cubes were cast from the concrete pour | | | COL-04 | Pour Ref / Element
Acceptance: Pour ID or element description matching Pour Register | Reference to the concrete pour (link to QC-CON-REG-001) and element concreted | | | COL-05 | Grade
Acceptance: As per design specification; must match pour grade | Concrete grade (e.g., M25, M30, M40, M50) | | | COL-06 | Mix Design
Acceptance: Approved mix design ID/reference; traceability to proportions | Reference to approved mix design document (IS 10262:2009) | | | COL-07 | No. of Cubes
Acceptance: Typically 6 cubes per set: 3 for 7-day test + 3 for 28-day test (minimum 1 set per 30 m³) | Total number of cube specimens in the set | | | COL-08 | Mould IDs
Acceptance: Calibrated moulds per IS 456, IDs recorded for traceability | Unique identifiers of the 150mm cube moulds used | | | COL-09 | Curing Method
Acceptance: Standard water immersion at 27±2°C or moist sand/cotton bed; per IS 516 | Curing method used for the cubes (e.g., water immersion, moist burlap) | | | COL-10 | Lab Sent To
Acceptance: Accredited testing lab with valid equipment calibration certificates | Name of testing laboratory | | | COL-11 | Date Sent
Acceptance: Documented delivery date; chain of custody maintained | Date cubes were dispatched to the testing lab | | | COL-12 | 7-Day Test Date
Acceptance: 7±1 days from casting date (per IS 516:1959 Clause 6.5) | Date when 7-day compression test was conducted | | | COL-13 | 7-Day Results - Cube 1 (MPa)
Acceptance: Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision | Compressive strength of first cube specimen at 7 days | | | COL-14 | 7-Day Results - Cube 2 (MPa)
Acceptance: Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision | Compressive strength of second cube specimen at 7 days | | | COL-15 | 7-Day Results - Cube 3 (MPa)
Acceptance: Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision | Compressive strength of third cube specimen at 7 days | | | COL-16 | 7-Day Average (MPa)
Acceptance: Mean of Cube 1, 2, 3; calculated value in MPa | Average compressive strength of 3 cubes at 7 days | | | COL-17 | 7-Day Pass/Fail
Acceptance: PASS if average ≥ fck - 3 MPa (tolerance allowance); FAIL if below | Pass/Fail verdict at 7 days (informational; IS 456 primarily uses 28-day for acceptance) | | | COL-18 | 28-Day Test Date
Acceptance: 28±1 days from casting date (per IS 516:1959 Clause 6.5) | Date when 28-day compression test was conducted | | | COL-19 | 28-Day Results - Cube 1 (MPa)
Acceptance: Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision; primary acceptance criterion per IS 456 | Compressive strength of first cube specimen at 28 days | | | COL-20 | 28-Day Results - Cube 2 (MPa)
Acceptance: Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision; primary acceptance criterion per IS 456 | Compressive strength of second cube specimen at 28 days | | | COL-21 | 28-Day Results - Cube 3 (MPa)
Acceptance: Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision; primary acceptance criterion per IS 456 | Compressive strength of third cube specimen at 28 days | | | COL-22 | 28-Day Average (MPa)
Acceptance: Mean of Cube 1, 2, 3; calculated value in MPa. Accept if: Average ≥ (fck + 0.825×SD) AND Each individual ≥ (fck - 3) MPa | Average compressive strength of 3 cubes at 28 days | | | COL-23 | 28-Day Pass/Fail
Acceptance: PASS if both conditions met: (1) Average ≥ (fck + 0.825×SD) AND (2) All individuals ≥ (fck - 3). FAIL if either condition fails; triggers NCR and remedial investigation | Pass/Fail verdict at 28 days (final acceptance criterion per IS 456:2000) | | | COL-24 | NCR No (if fail)
Acceptance: NCR ID linked to defect management system; leave blank if PASS | Non-Conformance Report number if 28-day test failed | | | COL-25 | Remarks
Acceptance: Document concrete appearance, test anomalies, core sampling decision, or remedial measures | Any observations, defects, or actions taken | | | CRITERIA. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA REFERENCE (IS 456:2000 Table 11) | | ACC-01 | Individual Cube Strength
Acceptance: Each cube ≥ (fck - 3) MPa. If any cube fails, element requires investigation (core testing per IS 1199:1959 Cl. 15) | Each tested cube must achieve minimum strength | | | ACC-02 | Average Cube Strength
Acceptance: Average ≥ (fck + 0.825×SD) where SD = standard deviation of all results in the acceptance group. Typical SD ≈ 2-3 MPa for controlled concrete | Average of 3 cubes must exceed specified threshold | | | ACC-03 | Sampling Frequency
Acceptance: 1 set per 30 m³ (or part thereof); 1 set per day minimum. Set = 6 cubes (3 at 7-day, 3 at 28-day) | Minimum number of cube sets per project phase | | | ACC-04 | Core Testing Trigger
Acceptance: If 28-day cube average < (fck + 0.825×SD) OR any individual < (fck - 3) MPa. Minimum 3 cores per 1000 m² of element surface, 150mm diameter, tested per IS 1199 Cl. 15 | When core testing of in-situ concrete becomes mandatory | | REG. CUBE SPECIMEN LIFECYCLE LOG - COLUMN DEFINITIONS COL-01S.No Serial number for each cube set entry (IS 516:1959) ✓ Sequential numbering from 1 onwards COL-02Cube Set ID Unique identifier for the cube set (e.g., SET-001, CS-P1-001) (IS 516:1959) ✓ Unique across project; linked to Pour Register (QC-CON-REG-001) COL-03Date Cast Date and time when cubes were cast from the concrete pour (IS 516:1959 Cl. 5.1) ✓ Same as pour date; time of casting recorded (HH:MM) COL-04Pour Ref / Element Reference to the concrete pour (link to QC-CON-REG-001) and element concreted (IS 516:1959) ✓ Pour ID or element description matching Pour Register COL-05Grade Concrete grade (e.g., M25, M30, M40, M50) (IS 456:2000, IS 516:1959) ✓ As per design specification; must match pour grade COL-06Mix Design Reference to approved mix design document (IS 10262:2009) (IS 10262:2009) ✓ Approved mix design ID/reference; traceability to proportions COL-07No. of Cubes Total number of cube specimens in the set (IS 516:1959 Cl. 5.2) ✓ Typically 6 cubes per set: 3 for 7-day test + 3 for 28-day test (minimum 1 set per 30 m³) COL-08Mould IDs Unique identifiers of the 150mm cube moulds used (IS 516:1959 Cl. 5.3) ✓ Calibrated moulds per IS 456, IDs recorded for traceability COL-09Curing Method Curing method used for the cubes (e.g., water immersion, moist burlap) (IS 516:1959 Cl. 5.6, IS 456:2000 Cl. 13.5) ✓ Standard water immersion at 27±2°C or moist sand/cotton bed; per IS 516 COL-10Lab Sent To Name of testing laboratory (IS 516:1959) ✓ Accredited testing lab with valid equipment calibration certificates COL-11Date Sent Date cubes were dispatched to the testing lab (IS 516:1959) ✓ Documented delivery date; chain of custody maintained COL-127-Day Test Date Date when 7-day compression test was conducted (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6) ✓ 7±1 days from casting date (per IS 516:1959 Clause 6.5) COL-137-Day Results - Cube 1 (MPa) Compressive strength of first cube specimen at 7 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4) ✓ Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision COL-147-Day Results - Cube 2 (MPa) Compressive strength of second cube specimen at 7 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4) ✓ Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision COL-157-Day Results - Cube 3 (MPa) Compressive strength of third cube specimen at 7 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4) ✓ Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision COL-167-Day Average (MPa) Average compressive strength of 3 cubes at 7 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4, IS 456:2000 Table 11) ✓ Mean of Cube 1, 2, 3; calculated value in MPa COL-177-Day Pass/Fail Pass/Fail verdict at 7 days (informational; IS 456 primarily uses 28-day for acceptance) (IS 456:2000) ✓ PASS if average ≥ fck - 3 MPa (tolerance allowance); FAIL if below COL-1828-Day Test Date Date when 28-day compression test was conducted (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6) ✓ 28±1 days from casting date (per IS 516:1959 Clause 6.5) COL-1928-Day Results - Cube 1 (MPa) Compressive strength of first cube specimen at 28 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4) ✓ Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision; primary acceptance criterion per IS 456 COL-2028-Day Results - Cube 2 (MPa) Compressive strength of second cube specimen at 28 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4) ✓ Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision; primary acceptance criterion per IS 456 COL-2128-Day Results - Cube 3 (MPa) Compressive strength of third cube specimen at 28 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4) ✓ Recorded strength in MPa to 0.5 MPa precision; primary acceptance criterion per IS 456 COL-2228-Day Average (MPa) Average compressive strength of 3 cubes at 28 days (IS 516:1959 Cl. 6.4, IS 456:2000 Table 11) ✓ Mean of Cube 1, 2, 3; calculated value in MPa. Accept if: Average ≥ (fck + 0.825×SD) AND Each individual ≥ (fck - 3) MPa COL-2328-Day Pass/Fail Pass/Fail verdict at 28 days (final acceptance criterion per IS 456:2000) (IS 456:2000 Table 11, IS 516:1959) ✓ PASS if both conditions met: (1) Average ≥ (fck + 0.825×SD) AND (2) All individuals ≥ (fck - 3). FAIL if either condition fails; triggers NCR and remedial investigation COL-24NCR No (if fail) Non-Conformance Report number if 28-day test failed (IS 456:2000) ✓ NCR ID linked to defect management system; leave blank if PASS COL-25Remarks Any observations, defects, or actions taken (IS 516:1959, IS 456:2000) ✓ Document concrete appearance, test anomalies, core sampling decision, or remedial measures CRITERIA. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA REFERENCE (IS 456:2000 Table 11) ACC-01Individual Cube Strength Each tested cube must achieve minimum strength (IS 456:2000 Table 11) ✓ Each cube ≥ (fck - 3) MPa. If any cube fails, element requires investigation (core testing per IS 1199:1959 Cl. 15) ACC-02Average Cube Strength Average of 3 cubes must exceed specified threshold (IS 456:2000 Table 11) ✓ Average ≥ (fck + 0.825×SD) where SD = standard deviation of all results in the acceptance group. Typical SD ≈ 2-3 MPa for controlled concrete ACC-03Sampling Frequency Minimum number of cube sets per project phase (IS 456:2000, IS 1199:1959) ✓ 1 set per 30 m³ (or part thereof); 1 set per day minimum. Set = 6 cubes (3 at 7-day, 3 at 28-day) ACC-04Core Testing Trigger When core testing of in-situ concrete becomes mandatory (IS 456:2000, IS 1199:1959 Cl. 15) ✓ If 28-day cube average < (fck + 0.825×SD) OR any individual < (fck - 3) MPa.
